method: Inspected installed primary-source implementations and actual exported ONNX weights/constants. Executed the actual installed TaskAlignedAssigner.select_candidates_in_gts and make_anchors on the measured floor box before constructing this report.

box_capacity.derivation: DFL is a softmax-weighted expectation of bins 0..reg_max-1. dist2bbox width=(left+right)*stride; therefore width <= 2*(reg_max-1)*stride.
box_capacity.conclusion: All 192 full-width floor GT boxes in val necessarily fail the single-box IoU50 matching rule at the declared input size. This explains at least192 of the observed195 platform FN; the remaining3 are not attributed by this architecture proof.

actual_anchor_probe.assigner_rule: stride_val=stride[1] for multi-level heads; enlarge any GT side smaller than stride_val about its center; center must be strictly inside enlarged box.

rejected_second_candidate.description: Keep reg_max8; append stride16 and stride32 Conv stages; Detect inputs [2,5,7], strides[4,8,32].
rejected_second_candidate.reason: Range alone does not fix training assignment: nearest stride32 anchor row is y240, outside the expanded y230..238 candidate box. The new head receives no eligible positive floor anchors for this fixed geometry.

reg_max32_alternative.interpretation: Installed Detect defines c2=max(16,ch[0]//4,4*reg_max); this widens regression convolutions at both existing high-resolution heads. Mathematical range improves, but added CPU cost and thin-box localization need independent evidence. No candidate trained or recommended for this release.

decision.future_work: Evaluate terrain geometry as a distinct task with actual anchor eligibility, representable regression distances and measured CPU cost before starting a new controlled architecture experiment.

limitations: Export inspection proves the model architecture and geometric limit, not empirical success of an untrained alternative.
Anchor counts use the actual fixed320 input and measured4px floor geometry; different padding, scale, augmentation or assigner versions require a new check.
IoU bound is for each individual box; this evaluator does not merge several predicted fragments into a full-width ground-truth box.
No heldout test outputs were read; candidate selection remained fixed before holdout.
